evidence.reason: The launch record is appended after Popen() but before the try/finally that terminates and reaps the child. If Recorder.append() raises (e.g., an I/O failure), boot exits without stopping the spawned systemd-run/QEMU process, and the log is not closed on that path. That is an ordinary error-path defect in existing launch handling; moving the append into the protected try block is the minimal compatible fix.
